verdict.rationale: v0 is described as an AI agent driven through chat (v0-probe-1, v0-docs-19). The SDK shows a plain-English message like 'Build me a personal website' creating a chat (v0-gh-1), and the agent plans, creates tasks, connects databases and fixes deployment failures on its own (v0-docs-35, v0-docs-9); community users confirm going from prompts to a deployed app (v0-comm-1, v0-comm-4). Missing for 10: no explicit first-party doc of natural-language chat as the control surface for every operation, and several actions (Fix CI, Fix Conflicts, the Cmd+K command palette) are shown as menus or buttons rather than natural-language commands.
